elden_ring.name: Elden Ring
elden_ring.description: An action RPG developed by FromSoftware and published by Bandai Namco. Features open-world exploration, challenging combat, and deep lore created in collaboration with George R.R. Martin.

baldurs_gate_3.name: Baldur's Gate 3
baldurs_gate_3.description: A story-rich RPG based on Dungeons & Dragons 5th edition. Features turn-based combat, deep character customization, and meaningful choices that affect the story.

the_witcher_3.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
the_witcher_3.description: An open-world action RPG following Geralt of Rivia. Features a massive world, branching storylines, and morally complex choices.

hollow_knight.name: Hollow Knight
hollow_knight.description: A challenging 2D metroidvania with beautiful hand-drawn art, tight controls, and atmospheric exploration.

god_of_war.name: God of War (2018)
god_of_war.description: A reimagining of the God of War series featuring Kratos and his son Atreus in Norse mythology. Combines action combat with emotional storytelling.

stardew_valley.name: Stardew Valley
stardew_valley.description: A farming simulation RPG where you inherit your grandfather's farm. Features farming, fishing, mining, relationships, and community building.

hades.name: Hades
hades.description: A roguelike dungeon crawler where you play as Zagreus escaping the underworld. Features fast-paced combat, Greek mythology, and compelling narrative.

minecraft.name: Minecraft
minecraft.description: A sandbox game focused on creativity, exploration, and survival. Build anything you can imagine with blocks in procedurally generated worlds.

resident_evil_4.name: Resident Evil 4 Remake
resident_evil_4.description: A survival horror game following Leon Kennedy's mission to rescue the president's daughter. Features intense combat and atmospheric horror.

zelda_totk.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
zelda_totk.description: An open-world adventure game and sequel to Breath of the Wild. Features innovative building mechanics and expansive exploration.

hades_ii.name: Hades II
hades_ii.description: A god-like rogue-like dungeon crawler where you play as Melinoë, the Princess of the Underworld, to confront the Titan of Time. Features deep narrative and addictive combat.

hollow_knight_silksong.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
hollow_knight_silksong.description: The long-awaited sequel to the award-winning action-adventure. Explore a haunted kingdom of silk and song as Hornet, the princess-protector of Hallownest.
similar_games: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

crimson_desert.name: Crimson Desert
crimson_desert.description: An open-world action-adventure featuring a gritty story of mercenaries fighting for survival in the vast continent of Pywel. Features high-fidelity combat and dragon riding.

marvels_wolverine.name: Marvel's Wolverine
marvels_wolverine.description: A standalone game from Insomniac focusing on Logan. Expect a darker, more mature tone with visceral combat and a cinematic narrative true to the character's roots.

gears_of_war_e_day.name: Gears of War: E-Day
gears_of_war_e_day.description: A prequel set 14 years before the original game, depicting the emergence of the Locust Horde through the eyes of Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago.

slay_the_spire_2.name: Slay the Spire 2
slay_the_spire_2.description: The sequel to the definitive roguelike deckbuilder. Return to the Spire with new characters, new cards, and new ways to play in a completely rebuilt engine.

resident_evil_requiem.name: Resident Evil Requiem
resident_evil_requiem.description: The latest mainline entry in the survival horror series. Features a dual-protagonist structure and a return to more atmospheric, claustrophobic horror environments.

subnautica_2.name: Subnautica 2
subnautica_2.description: A sequel to the beloved underwater survival game, introducing a brand-new alien world to explore and, for the first time, optional 4-player cooperative play.

claired_obscur_expedition_33.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
claired_obscur_expedition_33.description: A reactive turn-based RPG inspired by Belle Époque France. Players lead an expedition to destroy the Paintress before she erases more of humanity.

metroid_prime_4_beyond.name: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
metroid_prime_4_beyond.description: Samus Aran returns for a new first-person adventure across the stars. Master her signature abilities to survive a war against the Space Pirates and Sylux.

control_resonant.name: Control Resonant
control_resonant.description: The sequel to the 2019 supernatural hit. Jesse Faden faces a new internal and external threat within the Oldest House as the FBC expands its reach.

phantom_blade_zero.name: Phantom Blade Zero
phantom_blade_zero.description: A fast-paced 'Kung-fu-punk' action game featuring stylish swordplay and a dark fantasy world. Players take on the role of an elite assassin with 66 days to live.

dragon_quest_vii_reimagined.name: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
dragon_quest_vii_reimagined.description: A ground-up remake of the massive PS1 classic. Explore an archipelago of islands as you travel through time to restore the world to its former glory.

fable.name: Fable
fable.description: A reboot of the beloved franchise. Return to Albion, a land of heroes and villains, where your choices shape the world and your character's legacy.

south_of_midnight.name: South of Midnight
south_of_midnight.description: A third-person action-adventure set in the American Deep South. Play as Hazel, a Weaver of magic, as she repairs a broken world and confronts mythical creatures.

doom_the_dark_ages.name: DOOM: The Dark Ages
doom_the_dark_ages.description: The origin story of the Doom Slayer's rage. Set in a dark fantasy medieval world, use shields, morning stars, and mechs to crush the demonic legions.

hytale.name: Hytale
hytale.description: A massive sandbox RPG that combines the creative freedom of Minecraft with the depth of a traditional RPG. Features procedural worlds and extensive modding tools.

beyond_good_and_evil_2.name: Beyond Good & Evil 2
beyond_good_and_evil_2.description: A spiritual successor to the cult classic. Travel through System 3, a solar system where corporations fight for power and hybrid slaves fight for freedom.

mixtape.name: Mixtape
mixtape.description: A coming-of-age adventure following three teenagers on their last night of high school, experienced through a series of vignettes set to a legendary soundtrack.

arknights_endfield.name: Arknights: Endfield
arknights_endfield.description: An action RPG set in the Arknights universe. Players lead a team to explore the planet Talos-II, build bases, and engage in real-time tactical combat.

tomb_raider_legacy_of_atlantis.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
tomb_raider_legacy_of_atlantis.description: A modern remake of the original 1996 Tomb Raider. Lara Croft returns to her roots in a globetrotting adventure to find the Scion of Atlantis.

monster_hunter_wilds.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
monster_hunter_wilds.description: The latest evolution in the Monster Hunter series, featuring living, breathing ecosystems and seamless transitions between exploration and combat.

forza_horizon_6.name: Forza Horizon 6
forza_horizon_6.description: The premier open-world racing series heads to a stunning new location (rumored to be Japan), featuring the most diverse car list and weather systems yet.

ace_combat_8.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
ace_combat_8.description: A return to the Strangereal universe with cutting-edge aerial dogfighting and a cinematic story about the pilots who change the course of history.

bio_shock_isolation.name: BioShock: Isolation
bio_shock_isolation.description: Set in a new dystopian city with a 'two-city' dynamic (upper and lower), this entry explores the philosophical and societal consequences of isolated evolution.

last_of_us_part_2.name: The Last of Us Part II
last_of_us_part_2.description: A brutal tale of revenge and consequences set in a post-pandemic America, following Ellie on a journey through Seattle.

animal_crossing_nh.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
animal_crossing_nh.description: Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise as you explore, create, and customize.

ratchet_clank_rift_apart.name: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart
ratchet_clank_rift_apart.description: Go dimension-hopping with Ratchet and Clank as they take on an evil emperor from another reality.

metroid_dread.name: Metroid Dread
metroid_dread.description: Samus Aran faces a mysterious new threat on planet ZDR in this return to the classic 2D Metroid style.
similar_games: Ori and the Will of the Wisps

psychonauts_2.name: Psychonauts 2
psychonauts_2.description: Razputin Aquato, trained acrobat and powerful young psychic, realizes his dream of joining the Psychonauts.

horizon_forbidden_west.name: Horizon Forbidden West
horizon_forbidden_west.description: Aloy braves the Forbidden West, a majestic but dangerous frontier that conceals mysterious new threats.

marvels_spider_man_2.name: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
marvels_spider_man_2.description: Peter Parker and Miles Morales return for an exciting new adventure in the critically acclaimed franchise.

alan_wake_2.name: Alan Wake II
alan_wake_2.description: A string of ritualistic murders threatens Bright Falls, an idyllic small-town community in the Pacific Northwest.

black_myth_wukong.name: Black Myth: Wukong
black_myth_wukong.description: An action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology, based on the classic novel Journey to the West.

helldivers_2.name: Helldivers 2
helldivers_2.description: Join the Helldivers and fight for freedom across a hostile galaxy in a fast, frantic third-person shooter.

ghost_of_yotei.name: Ghost of Yōtei
ghost_of_yotei.description: Set in 1603, a new protagonist named Atsu embarks on a journey in the lands surrounding Mount Yōtei.

clair_obscur_expedition_33.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
clair_obscur_expedition_33.description: A reactive turn-based RPG where you lead an expedition to destroy the Paintress once and for all.
